Record D01-01. Round 01. Sheet 001.

A package is counted before it joins the working stock. The outer label is useful for routing, but the contents decide the record. Open one container at a time and keep its loose pieces together until the count is complete.
The tray for item K001 showed a pale diagonal mark. The mark remained visible after a dry wipe. Its position was recorded so that a later check can tell whether it has spread.

If the label and the contents disagree, preserve both readings in the note. A neat total is less useful than a traceable difference. Set the container aside without changing the label, then ask for a second count using the same unit.
